runtime: Isolated PHP HTTP simulator and synthetic session fixtures on Android/Termux

scenarios.method: Persisted answer is retried using its original request identity; no network proxy or actual packet drop was used.

scenarios.result: Confirms persisted answer without a second advance.
Previously persisted answer is kept; no key is disclosed.
Exactly one answer remains authoritative and current question advances once.
Active session restores its saved answer and authoritative answered count.
Navigation does not skip beyond the question reached by the save.
Expired-before-processing fixture rejects the answer and retains the saved answers.

scenarios.method: Persisted attempt/statistics bytes are compared before and after a same-session finish retry.

scenarios.result: Retry resolves to the original result without changing attempt, weakness or statistics records.
Concurrent requests resolve to one persisted attempt.
Ownership/session resilience regressions reject foreign learner access.

offline_answers: UNSUPPORTED; answer persistence and exam operations require connectivity. No local answer queue or answer-key-bearing offline cache was added.
limitations: Lost responses are modeled by replaying the exact persisted request through the isolated simulator; physical network interruption was not induced.
No device power-loss test was performed.
